correctness.rationale: Every labeled tournament n<=7 is enumerated exactly once by the 2^(n choose 2) arc encoding, and all 2^n states by full integer transition tables. Two distinct exact cycle methods agree on all graph-maximal-period counts; topological pruning computes every first periodic entry distance, exact witnesses attain extrema, and 5040 permutation checks prove both reported relabeling orbit decompositions. No infinite inference or floating-point sign decision is involved.
